title: FRET calibration
_comment: The report of a finished (or loaded) calibration: the factors with their uncertainties, the populations it found, what the window's constants became, and the calibration's whole text -- with keeping the calibration or the text beside it. The Qt window shows the text only; the tables are the same numbers, readable at a glance.

columns.title: Factor
columns.tooltip: α leakage, δ direct excitation, γ detection/QY ratio, β excitation flux ratio (Hellenkamp et al. 2018); R₀ the Förster radius.
Standard error from the bootstrap (population assignment held fixed).

columns.title: Written
columns.tooltip: Whether the factor was written into the window, or held at the value it had (the options' Determine toggles).

columns.title: E
columns.tooltip: Accurate FRET efficiency of the population.

sections.title: Population-wise factors
sections.description: Whether each FRET population got its own γ: the mode, the model the BIC selected (shared or per population) with both BICs, whether the per-population model was identifiable, and the vector constants written. A written vector is an expandable row of the Parameters tab; right-click > Make scalar turns it back into one value.

sections.title: Full report
sections.description: The calibration's whole text, as the Qt window's report shows it and as Save report writes it.

buttons.label: Save calibration…
buttons.description: Keep this calibration: into the .pto measurement it was determined from, or a separate *.fretcal.json file.

buttons.label: Save report…
buttons.description: Write the report text to a file.
